result.markdown:
To compare **Gemini 4** coding prompt examples, benchmarks, and interactive demos, several primary developer hubs, official model documentation sites, and community showcases host these resources:[aiidelist.com](https://aiidelist.com/blog/gemini-4-carbon-examples-prompts#:~:text=Key%20Takeaways%20*%20Gemini%204%20Carbon%20community,produced%20an%20output.%20*%20Prompt%20availability%20varies.)

### 1. Official Google & DeepMind Resources
* **Google DeepMind Model Cards:** Provides the official benchmarking sheets, evaluation datasets (such as SWE-sweep, Terminal-Bench, and reasoning suites), and capability breakdowns across the Gemini 4 lineup (**Hydrogen**, **Argon**, and **Carbon**).[www.datacamp.com](https://www.datacamp.com/blog/gemini-4-hydrogen#:~:text=Other%20headline%20results%20Google%20published%3A%20Terminal-Bench%204.1%3A,Knowledge%20Agent%3A%2053.4%25%20Agent%20Arena%3A%20fifth%20place.) 
* **Google AI Studio & Official Blog Showcases:** Google regularly updates its feature posts (such as *Gemini 4 Argon in Action*) with structured walkthroughs, live sandbox embeds, and initial prompt descriptions for complex coding tasks like 3D physics engines, Three.js applications, and repository-scale refactoring.[blog.google](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/gemini/gemini-4-argon-in-action/#:~:text=Googlers%20have%20used%20Argon%20to%20prototype%20complex,physical%20space%20and%20our%20AI%20Studio%20how-to.)

### 2. Specialized Developer & Benchmark Curators
* **AI IDE List (`aiidelist.com`):** Features deep-dive breakdowns comparing Gemini 4 prompt architectures, including side-by-side analyses of community-shared visual demos (such as interactive voxel environments, procedural animations, and SVG/canvas games) alongside the underlying prompt engineering practices.[aiidelist.com](https://aiidelist.com/blog/best-gemini-4-argon-prompts-examples#:~:text=original%20short%20prompt%20public%20%7C%20%7C%202,Interactive%20soft-body%20physics%20test%20%7C%20Community%20comparison%3B)
* **PrompTessor:** Publishes practical evaluation guides, comparative prompting templates, and optimization checklists specifically tailored for Gemini 4's reasoning tiers (low, medium, high, and xhigh thinking levels).[promptessor.com](https://promptessor.com/blog/gemini-4-argon-prompting-guide#:~:text=Test%20prompt%20and%20configuration%20changes%20on%20representative,it%20can%20be%20applied%20to%20the%20evidence%3F)
* **DataCamp & Technical Explainers:** Offers metric-by-metric analyses stacking Gemini 4 models against competing frontier options on software engineering benchmarks.
